issue: ‘आरती हरनि विश्वधैया की’: हरनि (remover) names no object, and धैया is a rhyme form (read as धाय/धाई, wet-nurse, foster-mother, Platts).
our reading: the āratī of her who takes away sorrow, the nurse of the world
alternatives: हरनि as a separate epithet (the remover, of sins or ills); धैया as ‘sustainer’ (धारण करनेवाली)

issue: ‘विश्व जैया’: जैया is a rhyme form not in Platts; read as जाया/जननी (she who gives birth).
alternatives: ‘she who brings life to the world’ (जिवैया)
